```plato

    //==
    // # Marching cubes — the lattice driver

    // The isosurface at isoLevel through a scalar lattice of nodeCounts sampled
    // nodes, as unwelded triangles. `valueAt` reports the sample at a node and
    // `pointAt` its world position; both are called only with in-range indices.
    // A lattice of n nodes on an axis marches n - 1 cubes, so an axis with fewer
    // than two nodes contributes nothing.
    //
    // The case table is read once here and passed into every cube.
    MarchingCubesLattice(nodeCounts: IntegerVector3, valueAt: Function3<Integer, Integer, Integer, Number>, pointAt: Function3<Integer, Integer, Integer, Point3D>, isoLevel: Number)
        : TriangleArray3D
    {
        var table = TriangleArray3D.MarchingCubesCaseTable;
        var columns = (nodeCounts.X - 1).Max(0);
        var rows = (nodeCounts.Y - 1).Max(0);
        var layers = (nodeCounts.Z - 1).Max(0);
        var plane = columns * rows;
        var cells = MapRange(plane * layers, n =>
            IntegerVector3(n % columns, (n / columns) % rows, n / plane));
        return TriangleArray3D(
            cells.FlatMap(cell => MarchingCubesCell(table, cell, valueAt, pointAt, isoLevel)));
    }
```
